meta.title: "Are you disagreeing or attacking?" — how to teach your child to argue on the merits, without conflict | Sila Slova
meta.description: Teach your child to separate the idea from the person: disagree on the merits and not make it personal. Game-based course for children aged 10–16.

hero.headline: Your child disagrees — and the conversation instantly turns into a fight?
hero.subheadline: "You don't understand anything", "you're one to talk", "there's no point talking to you". Instead of a discussion — an attack. Because your child can't tell disagreement from an attack.

media.alt: Two children in an argument that escalates into conflict instead of discussion

pain.title: Disagreement or attack — and any "no" turns into a fight
pain.body:
Your child says "I think differently" — and the conversation instantly explodes. "You don't understand anything", "you're one to talk", "there's no point talking to you" — at school, in chats, in everyday conversation. Instead of a discussion, an attack begins. The child either fires back or goes silent.

But disagreement isn't an attack. You can disagree with an idea without touching the person. When the two get mixed up, any "I think differently" feels like a personal insult — both theirs and the other person's.

Without the skill to separate the position from the person, the conversation quickly turns into a quarrel. The result — the child either "fights with words" or stops speaking up altogether. Not because they're aggressive, but because they don't see the difference between "I disagree" and "you're bad".

faq.q: Is it a game or a learning course?
faq.a: Both at the same time. "Sila Slova" looks like a detective series, but every episode contains a hidden critical thinking lesson.

faq.q: What age is it suitable for?
faq.a: Ideal for 10–16 year olds. At this age, children are receptive to new thinking patterns and are still forming their views.

faq.q: How much time is needed each day?
faq.a: 15–20 minutes per episode. Flexible schedule — your child can come back at any convenient time.

faq.q: Is registration required for the demo?
faq.a: No. The demo episode is fully open — no registration, no subscription, no personal data required.
